summary: Delete the blocked-actions command-text matcher: branch protection, the pr-ready rollup and the merge-if-eligible CLI are the controls (AISDLC-1014)

options.description: Remove the command-text matcher and its blocked-actions table; keep blockedPaths and the lease-push guard; archive AISDLC-1012 (AISDLC-1014)
Keep a hook that matches shell grammar (executable plus subcommand), never free text (AISDLC-1012 as filed)
Grammar matcher for the gh landing and close subcommands only; drop every git pattern

body: The PreToolUse hook enforce-blocked-actions.js refuses any Bash command whose text contains a blocked-action phrase (raw gh landing and close subcommands, the git merge subcommand, plain force push, hard reset, capital-D branch delete, bare stash drop). The match is on free text, so JSON fields, paths, echo strings, heredocs and handoff notes trigger it: ten false refusals in this repo today (including the command that tried to record this decision), six in the adopter. AISDLC-1012 proposed a shell-grammar matcher. The operator re-evaluated the requirement: the outcome (nothing lands on main outside the sanctioned path) is enforced server-side by branch protection, the ai-sdlc/pr-ready rollup and cli-merge-if-eligible; the local text guard adds false refusals and no enforcement. Weakening of a local control, compensated by the server-side ones; the prompt rule stays as instruction. Reverse by restoring the matcher from git history or landing AISDLC-1012.
